summary.en-US: Logs PartCAD plugins in to the sites they work with: captures the credentials a plugin asks for and hands them to PartCAD on this computer.

description.en-US: PartCAD's command line installs this extension into a browser profile of its own when you run `pc login`. It does nothing until PartCAD opens a login page on this computer (127.0.0.1); it then shows a banner on the site PartCAD names, points at what to click, and once you are logged in reads exactly the values the PartCAD plugin asked for -- a cookie, a value in the page's storage, a value on the page, or one you paste -- and sends them to PartCAD on this computer, and nowhere else. It acts only on the sites the login names, only while a login is in progress, and only for as long as PartCAD waits.

version.approval_notes: The source is not built, bundled or minified: the package is the directory browsers/firefox of https://github.com/partcad/partcad as it is. The extension is inert until a page at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/partcad/login/<nonce>/start (served by PartCAD's `pc login`) hands it a login request; browsers/README.md describes the protocol and why each permission is needed, and tests/browsers/conftest.py is a stand-in for that page that can be used to try it.
